_note: The owner's STANDING AUTHORIZATION for the Athena attendant (DND-285). scripts/setup-athena-attend MERGES the entries in .permissions.allow into the ATTENDED project's .claude/settings.json (merge, never clobber -- same discipline as scripts/setup-hooks). Only the routine attend calls run without a prompt; everything else prompts (deny-by-default; T5 relays the prompt). Entries name EXACTLY the attend procedure's routine calls -- no edit/git/forge/mail tool and no Bash(*) wildcard is ever allowed here (the installer self-test asserts this statically). Bin paths are MAIN-checkout absolute (/home/cjpoll/dev/custom/...), NEVER a worktree path (a worktree path vanishes on cleanup and the allowlist then silently matches nothing, so every attend call would prompt forever -- architect ruling 2026-09-22). The tail entry's __ATTEND_LEDGER__ is a placeholder the installer replaces with the resolved per-project ledger path (~/.local/state/athena-attend/<project>/ledger.log); this _note key is not part of .permissions.allow and never reaches the merged settings.
